title_sq: Ne Laprake, Tek Kompleksi Aura, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Super Planimetri !
description_sq: Ne Laprake, Tek Kompleksi Aura, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Super Planimetri !!! Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 88.1 m2 dhe siperfaqe neto 74 m2, ndodhet ne katin e pare banim te njeres prej godinave te kompleksit dhe organizohet nga korridori shperndares, salloni i ndenjes bashke me kendin e gatimit, dy dhomat e gjumit, tualet dhe nje ballkon. Orientimi i tij eshte Veri-Perendim. Kompleksi eshte i organizuar me dy kate parkimi nentoke, kati perdhe dedikuar totalisht ambienteve te biznesit dhe mbi te zhvillohen 10 kate banimi. Disa nga benefitet e kompleksit jane: fasade e veshur me termoizolim, sistem kapot ; dritare me dopjo xham me mbushje me gaz per minimizimin e zhurmave dhe termoizolim; izolim akustik ne ndarjet ndermjet apartamenteve; sistem i pergatitur i ngrohjes qendrore. Oborri i brendshem eshte nje hapesire e plotesuar me stola dhe gjelberim, ne pjesen e pasme te kompleksit, pjesa veri-lindore e tij.
title_en: In Laprake, at the Aura Complex, 2+1 apartment for sale, with a super floor plan!
description_en: In Laprake, near the Aura complex, 2+1 apartment for sale with super floor plan!!! The apartment with a total area of ​​88.1 m2 and a net area of ​​74 m2, is located on the first residential floor of one of the buildings of the complex and is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a balcony. Its orientation is North-West. The complex is organized with two floors of underground parking, the ground floor is completely dedicated to business premises and 10 residential floors will be developed above. Some of the benefits of the complex are: facade covered with thermal insulation, capot system; double-glazed windows with gas filling for noise reduction and thermal insulation; acoustic insulation in the partitions between apartments; prepared central heating system. The inner courtyard is a space filled with benches and greenery, at the back of the complex, its north-eastern part.
